title: Hatching Cosmic Egg
description: A large cracked white egg dominates the center, its shell breaking apart to reveal a glowing hot pink orb inside. Thorny black vines and green foliage wrap around the egg while a smaller broken eggshell and a green sun-like face with a pink starburst appear below against a starry black background.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a large cracked white eggshell floating in space, breaking open to reveal a radiant glowing hot pink orb at its center. Black thorny vines and green foliage entangle the shell. Below are smaller broken white eggshell fragments, a green circular face with closed eyes, and a bright pink starburst. Scattered grey leaves and a starry black background, dramatic lighting, illustrative style with bold outlines.
